domain: Pre-modern metrology and the maintenance of a calibration chain (bureau of weights and measures: prototype standards, calibration ledgers, periodic inter-comparison of working standards against a national primary, authorized unit conversion)
axioms: A value in circulation is only trustworthy if it traces, by a documented chain of intermediary standards, back to a primary standard of known provenance; a broken lineage makes the value formally worthless, not merely approximate.

Standards drift with time and use; a working standard not re-verified on its scheduled cadence is presumed drifted until re-proven, and re-verification is only meaningful if a divergence carries an obligated disposition.
Conversion between incommensurable local units requires an authorized, provenanced, versioned conversion table; an unbacked equivalence between two vendors' effort dials is a fabricated equivalence.

The certification metadata (who assayed, when, against which source/snapshot) is part of the value; a bare correctness tag with no certifier or date is uncertified and its drift is undetectable by construction.
An absent standard is itself a verdict and must be treated as suspect-until-proven, never allowed to silently decay into a numeric default.

A corrupted master standard silently poisons every derived copy downstream; the dangerous failure is the genuine old standard trusted long after the artifact beneath it crept, not the obviously-wrong measure.
primitives: primary standard vs. working standard vs. derived copy
inter-comparison / drift report and its obligated disposition
compat shim as a re-baselining conversion
failure_mode: Blind to runtime enforcement, fail-closed/fail-open behavior, and authority boundaries between harnesses — it audits whether a value can be traced and re-verified, not whether a constraint actually holds when the decision executes.
Can over-index on lineage bureaucracy and flag missing provenance metadata even where the value is low-stakes or the drift blast-radius is negligible.

Treats 'the world moved' (a superseded benchmark, a redefined vendor dial) as the primary threat and can under-weight failures that have nothing to do with data staleness (e.g. an adapter that ignores a correctly-provenanced gate).
